name: 清爽任务中台
positioning: 适合任务管理、轻量项目推进、团队协作和进度复盘类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system rounded sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts
design_tokens.shadow_style: soft lifted cards with generous white space

layout_rules: Use a wide light sidebar with a soft indigo active item and generous vertical rhythm.
Use a welcome panel with CSS illustration shapes, rounded metric cards, icon wells, and open white space.
Render task records as stacked cards rather than a dense operations table.
Use a centered detail dialog and friendly validation dialog styling.
Each sidebar item owns one complete mutually exclusive page view; narrow web layouts use an off-canvas sidebar.
interaction_contracts: Navigation synchronizes page visibility, aria-current, title, breadcrumb, hash, focus, and scroll position.
Period chips recalculate progress metrics and chart labels.
Task keyword, status, and owner filters plus reset update a truthful task-card list and empty state.
CSV export contains all current filtered records.
Detail dialogs bind to the correct task; confirmed progression updates task cards, overview metrics, insights, member load, and notifications.
Invite form validates name, role, and email before adding a collaborator.
Settings save and restore real in-memory display preferences.
Dialogs close by explicit controls or Escape and restore focus to the invoking control.

replace_from_development_document: members, notices, settings, and synthetic mock data
avoid: Mazer logos, screenshots, copy, illustrations, source code, or brand assets

single_file_compilation.asset_policy: inline SVG and CSS shapes only; no external URLs
